history-of-ai.evidence: Checked all three panels against sections 6 (quiet decades), 7 (the XOR proof), and 3 (the first winter). The repaired timeline now stays inside section 6, orders the 2006–2012 ingredients coherently, and no longer borrows the AlexNet result from section 8.
history-of-ai.facts: The backpropagation, statistical turn, Deep Blue, GPU, training-craft, and ImageNet cards match the room; the four XOR inequalities and OR/AND hidden-unit construction are exact; and the Minsky–Papert versus Lighthill distinction preserves theorem, judgment, audit, and hindsight as different claim types.
history-of-ai.uncertainty: Causal accounts of an AI winter are historiography rather than a single-variable experiment. The visual keeps the compute-and-data diagnosis marked as visible in hindsight and does not turn the funding narrative into a mathematical consequence.

evolution-of-ai.evidence: Checked the panels against sections 7 (selection-pressure table), 8 (the machine-translation lineage), and 2 (symbolic AI's resource fit and collapse). Each insertion heading directly supports its cards and caption.
evolution-of-ai.facts: The five overlapping eras reproduce the room's dated table, the translation sequence preserves rules, phrase statistics, neural sequence models, and general models as successive bottleneck changes, and the symbolic sequence accurately joins scarce compute, expert rules, XCON/Lisp machines, brittleness, and workstation disruption.
evolution-of-ai.uncertainty: The era boundaries overlap and are an explanatory taxonomy, not biological species boundaries. The agent phase and the word ‘now’ are perishable, so the current selection-pressure panel is explicitly dated 25 August 2026.
evolution-of-ai.must_fix: none — the visuals state the evolutionary framing as a model of selection pressures rather than a literal biological identity.

benchmarks.evidence: Checked the benchmark lifecycle against section 3, the five Goodhart mechanisms against section 4, and the HLE audit sequence against section 6. All cards remain within their declared evidence sections.
benchmarks.facts: The panels accurately separate contamination, test-focused training, leaderboard variants, instrument ownership, and answer-key defects. cybernetics.evidence: Checked the three-stop feedback timeline against section 2, Ashby's paper game against section 6, and the cybernetics/symbolic-AI/modern-ML comparison against section 7. The feedback timeline was narrowed so it no longer borrows later-room claims.

top-papers-ml.evidence: Checked the canon timeline against section 7, the full perceptron trace against section 8, and the generalization-theory comparison against section 6. Labels, dates, equations, and caveats all track the source.
top-papers-ml.facts: The OR trace starts at zero, makes four corrections, converges to weights (0,1,1), and yields dot products 0,1,1,2; changing the labels to XOR prevents convergence.
